description:
Pre-Authoring Analysis:
Tag and publish the rebranded baldaworks/acpchat project to GitHub Releases and npm registry as v1.1.1.

# acpchat Release v1.1.1 — Requirements Document

## 1. Overview
Cut release v1.1.1 on baldaworks/acpchat, trigger GitHub Actions omnidist-release workflow, verify GitHub Release assets (darwin/linux/windows tarballs) and npm package @baldaworks/acpchat@1.1.1.

## 2. Scope
### In Scope
- Tag v1.1.1 on main.
- Push v1.1.1 to origin (baldaworks/acpchat).
- Monitor GitHub Actions release workflow run.
- Verify GitHub Release v1.1.1 and 5 platform tarballs.
- Verify npm publication of @baldaworks/acpchat@1.1.1.

### Out of Scope
- Code refactoring beyond release publishing.

## 3. Definitions and Glossary
- Omnidist: Cross-platform packaging and distribution tool.

## 4. Requirements
- REQ-REL-001: Annotated git tag v1.1.1 MUST be created on main and pushed to origin.
- REQ-REL-002: GitHub Actions omnidist-release workflow MUST complete with success.
- REQ-REL-003: GitHub Release v1.1.1 MUST be published with 5 platform assets.
- REQ-REL-004: npm package @baldaworks/acpchat@1.1.1 MUST be published on registry.npmjs.org.

## 5. Constraints
- CON-001: GitHub Actions requires NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN secret for unattended npm publishing.

## 6. Dependencies
- DEP-001: gh CLI and npm CLI.

## 7. Assumptions
- ASM-001: baldaworks/acpchat repository secrets have NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN configured.

## 8. Risks
- RSK-001: Likelihood: Low, Impact: Low, Mitigation: Monitored via gh run view.

## 9. Revision History
- v1.0.0 (2026-09-01): Initial release specification for acpchat v1.1.1.

title: Rebrand normahq/acp-repl to baldaworks/acpchat
description:
Pre-Authoring Analysis:
The repository normahq/acp-repl provides an interactive terminal chat/REPL interface for any Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server. The initiative rebrands the project from normahq/acp-repl to baldaworks/acpchat.

# acpchat — Requirements Document

## 1. Overview
Rebrand the acp-repl repository to baldaworks/acpchat, migrating Go module paths, binary name, npm package scope, omnidist configuration, CI release workflows, documentation, and creating the GitHub repository baldaworks/acpchat.

## 2. Scope
### In Scope
- Go module rename from github.com/normahq/acp-repl to github.com/baldaworks/acpchat.
- CLI entrypoint rename from cmd/acp-repl to cmd/acpchat and binary name to acpchat.
- Package rename internal/apps/acprepl to internal/apps/acpchat.
- Cobra CLI usage and command strings update.
- Taskfile.yaml update to BINARY_NAME: acpchat and MAIN_PATH: ./cmd/acpchat.
- Omnidist configuration update in .omnidist/omnidist.yaml (profile acpchat, tool acpchat, npm package @baldaworks/acpchat, repo baldaworks/acpchat).
- GitHub Actions release workflow (.github/workflows/omnidist-release.yml) update with NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN, post-stage bin stripping, and target asset paths.
- README.md, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md documentation update.
- GitHub repository creation baldaworks/acpchat and remote update.
- Local directory rename to /home/bigboss/Projects/acpchat.

### Out of Scope
- Rewriting core REPL interaction or ADK runner logic.
- Breaking existing ACP protocol compatibility.

## 3. Definitions and Glossary
- ACP: Agent Client Protocol
- ADK: Agent Development Kit
- REPL: Read-Eval-Print Loop / interactive chat interface

## 4. Requirements
- REQ-MOD-001: The Go module MUST be renamed to github.com/baldaworks/acpchat and all internal imports updated.
- REQ-CLI-002: The CLI entrypoint MUST be located at cmd/acpchat producing binary acpchat.
- REQ-PKG-003: internal/apps/acprepl MUST be renamed to internal/apps/acpchat.
- REQ-TSK-004: Taskfile.yaml MUST define BINARY_NAME: acpchat and MAIN_PATH: ./cmd/acpchat.
- REQ-OMN-005: .omnidist/omnidist.yaml MUST configure profile acpchat, tool acpchat, and npm package @baldaworks/acpchat.
- REQ-WFL-006: .github/workflows/omnidist-release.yml MUST configure NPM_PACKAGE: @baldaworks/acpchat, use secrets.NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN, and strip bin from platform packages during staging.
- REQ-DOC-007: README.md and AGENTS.md MUST reflect acpchat branding and @baldaworks/acpchat installation.
- REQ-GIT-008: GitHub repository baldaworks/acpchat MUST be created, git remote updated, and pushed to origin main.
- REQ-DIR-009: The working directory MUST be renamed to /home/bigboss/Projects/acpchat.

## 5. Constraints
- CON-001: All existing tests MUST pass with go test -v -race ./...
- CON-002: Beads issue tracker prefix MUST be acpchat.

## 6. Dependencies
- DEP-001: gh CLI for GitHub repository creation and workflow triggers.
- DEP-002: Go 1.26+ toolchain.
- DEP-003: npm and omnidist for packaging.

## 7. Assumptions
- ASM-001: GitHub organization baldaworks is accessible via gh CLI.
- ASM-002: npm token in secrets.NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN will be used for publishing.

## 8. Risks
- RSK-001: Likelihood: Low, Impact: Medium, Mitigation: Ensure post-stage bin stripping is included in CI workflow to prevent npx bin linking collisions.

## 9. Revision History
- v1.0.0 (2026-09-01): Initial specification for acpchat rebranding.

# Design Document: Rebrand acp-repl to baldaworks/acpchat

## 1. Overview and Requirements Summary
This design guides the comprehensive migration and rebranding of the `normahq/acp-repl` codebase into `baldaworks/acpchat`.

- **REQ-MOD-001**: Module `github.com/baldaworks/acpchat` in `go.mod` and all internal imports.
- **REQ-CLI-002**: Entrypoint at `cmd/acpchat/main.go` and `cmd/acpchat/cmd/command.go` compiling binary `acpchat`.
- **REQ-PKG-003**: Renamed internal app package `internal/apps/acpchat`.
- **REQ-TSK-004**: `Taskfile.yaml` build tasks targeting `acpchat`.
- **REQ-OMN-005**: `.omnidist/omnidist.yaml` configuring profile `acpchat` and package `@baldaworks/acpchat`.
- **REQ-WFL-006**: `.github/workflows/omnidist-release.yml` with NPM token env and post-stage platform bin stripping.
- **REQ-DOC-007**: `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `CLAUDE.md` documentation updates.
- **REQ-GIT-008**: GitHub repository creation `baldaworks/acpchat` and remote setup.
- **REQ-DIR-009**: Directory rename to `/home/bigboss/Projects/acpchat`.

## 2. Component Layout & Structural Changes
```
cmd/acpchat/
  main.go
  cmd/command.go
internal/
  apps/
    acpchat/
      acpchat.go
      acpchat_test.go
      repl_startup_test.go
.omnidist/
  omnidist.yaml
.github/
  workflows/
    omnidist-release.yml
```

## 3. Implementation Details
1. **Module & Internal Package**:
   - Update `go.mod` to `module github.com/baldaworks/acpchat`.
   - Rename `internal/apps/acprepl` -> `internal/apps/acpchat`.
   - Update package clause to `package acpchat`.
   - Update imports across the codebase to `github.com/baldaworks/acpchat/...`.
2. **CLI & Commands**:
   - Move `cmd/acp-repl` -> `cmd/acpchat`.
   - Update Cobra commands in `cmd/acpchat/cmd/command.go` to `Use: "acpchat [flags] -- <acp-server-cmd> [args...]"`.
3. **Omnidist & CI Workflow**:
   - Update `.omnidist/omnidist.yaml` profile to `acpchat`, tool to `acpchat`, package to `@baldaworks/acpchat`.
   - Update `.github/workflows/omnidist-release.yml` to package `acpchat` release archives, use `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN }}`, and run the post-stage platform bin deletion node script.
4. **Git Repository & Remote**:
   - Create repo `baldaworks/acpchat` via `gh repo create baldaworks/acpchat --public`.
   - Set remote origin `git@github.com:baldaworks/acpchat.git`.
   - Rename local folder to `/home/bigboss/Projects/acpchat`.
